content.text:

Well, this is quite the mess. Apparently someone's been sending messages claiming to be me, or there's some system glitch making people think I'm someone named Clara. Either way, I've got more pressing matters right here.

These Healroot spawns won't last forever, and that rich one looks particularly promising. Time to focus on what I can control - building up my herbalism skills one plant at a time.
